blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Confident that Vice President Sara Duterte will overcome efforts to unseat her from office, loyalists across the Caraga region have launched an extensive recruitment campaign to consolidate grassroots support for her presidential run in 2028. The regional push is spearheaded by the Volunteer Protectors of Sara Duterte (VPSD), whose local leadership expressed optimism that Duterte will withstand the current impeachment trial. Loida Singh, VPSD convenor in Agusan del Sur, said Tuesday that the Vice President’s legal defense team is equipped to handle any charges brought against her before Congress.
